assumptions: Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; every change here is reversible and synthetic-only.

Cross-vendor review was withdrawn for this package by the Product Owner on 2026-10-05 (step 2 item 1, evidence/WP-0A-A0-001/product-owner-disposition-2026-10-05-g0-step2.md; RFC-2026-024). Independence remains four distinct runs plus the conditional Security run, none acting on its own work.

acceptance_results.criterion: metadata.schema_ref rejects every one of the sixteen hostile forms that the shipped schema accepted, and the probe is recorded as having been run against the schema BEFORE the fix.
metadata.schema_ref still accepts a well-formed contract name, so the guard is not one that rejects everything.
A value that satisfies the contract-name shape and exceeds the bound is rejected, so the bound is tested independently of the shape.
Every reference field this package touches carries a maxLength.
The guard asserts behaviour, never pattern text.
npm run check stays green with no test skipped, and no declared unkilled ceiling rises.

security_privacy_cost_impact: data classification synthetic-only; secrets required false; network policy deny-unless-declared. No provider call, credential, migration or customer-data effect. Cost impact none: no metered resource is touched.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No schema, migration, provider call, credential or customer-data effect; Gate G0 forbids all of them and this package changed none.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes. No contract-catalog file, schema or fixture is touched. The guard is stricter: it walks the whole catalog, and a new unbounded reference field in any contract now fails CI unless it is recorded in KNOWN_UNBOUNDED with its owning package. A contract owner who bounds a listed field must remove its entry in the same change.
known_limitations: CTR-NTF-001 deep_link.target_ref remains unbounded. It belongs to A5 (contract owner) through WP-0A-CON-006, and it is reported, not fixed. Since 2026-10-06 it and its three unbounded neighbours (notification_id, message_key, dedupe_key) are in the guard's KNOWN_UNBOUNDED list, so they are visible, and the list fails when the owner bounds them until the entry is removed.

RESOLVED 2026-10-06 (was: "The 256-character bound is a DECLARED INFERENCE. The longest reference in the catalog is 51 characters; no baseline task states a limit. A reviewer who knows the real ceiling should set it."). The figure was wrong: the longest is 85 (ctr-usg-001 dedupe_key, valid fixture), or 48 counting *_ref only (A1 S-8, C0 F6). No baseline document states a limit. The bounds are now recorded as A0's decision as owner of the four contracts, under the Owner's 2026-09-28 instruction to carry out the work as A0 recommends (RFC-2026-009 R-2). 256 is load-bearing in migrations 050, 110 and 140 as length(...) <= 256 CHECK constraints, so a change in either direction needs a forward migration in the same change. A1's suggestion to lower schema_ref to 24 is recorded, not taken; it is CTR-EVT-001's owner's before freeze.

OWED by WP-0A-CON-001 (CTR-EVT-001's package; acknowledgement to /claude/r0_steward): the x-bound-note repeated on eight fields of contract-catalog/shared-kernel/ctr-evt-001/schema.json says the neighbouring fields accepted "four of the sixteen" hostile forms before the fix. They accepted sixteen of sixteen, and the note is wrong in every clause about event_type (A1 S-7, condition 1). The file is outside this package's writable paths. RFC-2026-009 R-3 records the true figures.

REPORTED, NOT FIXED: 49 reference-shaped fields in nine contracts this package does not own carry no bound.
